The answer (Shepherd's Bush) and distractors are all correct/plausible, but the stem's premise 'Loftus Road, QPR's home since 1917' is false as a continuous claim. QPR first moved to Loftus Road in 1917, but left for White City twice afterward (1931-1933, and part of the 1962-63 season) before returning for good in the middle of the 1962-63 season. It has NOT been their uninterrupted home since 1917 -- the correct unbroken-tenure date is 1963.
